title: Move the multi-minute task_sync tests out of the ordinary lib suite into the existing scale phase
outcome: Move the multi-minute task_sync tests out of the ordinary lib suite into the existing scale phase
acceptance: The evidence-import record-limit replay (~335 s on the Mac), near-capacity custody replay (~242 s) and 2,000-member atomic delta (~155 s) tests run in the existing scale-test phase of scripts/test-rust.sh / test-rust.ps1 instead of the ordinary `cargo test --lib` run, with no loss of coverage
An ordinary `cargo test --lib task_sync` on the Mac finishes well under the previous 936 s, recorded with per-test timings
